_readme: TEMPLATE. No robot details were supplied, so this file has one empty entry. Copy the entry once per robot and fill in every [FILL: ...] value. Do not invent values.
Prices not supplied are null. In the UI a null price is shown as 'Price on request', never as 0.
images: the first file is used for the grid card and the detail hero. The rest form the gallery. Files live in /public/images/robots/.
operations[].unit describes how priceAdd is charged, for example one-time or per month. Fill it only when the founder gives it.
The build fails if any '[FILL' text is still present in production.

_pricingLogic.status: ASSUMPTION. Confirm with the founder (see docs/QUESTIONS.md).
_pricingLogic.buy: estimatedTotal = modes.buy.basePrice + sum(priceAdd of selected operations)
_pricingLogic.build: estimatedTotal = modes.build.kitPrice + (modes.build.mentorDayRate * mentorDays) + (modes.build.perStudentMaterial * students) + sum(priceAdd of selected operations)
_pricingLogic.validation: students must be at least modes.build.minStudents; mentorDays must be a whole number of at least 1
_pricingLogic.nullRule: If any price needed for the chosen mode is null, show 'Price on request' instead of a total
_pricingLogic.company: Companies use the buy price plus selected operations. Customisation for the office is confirmed after the team visit.
